about: Assembling (docs/sandbox/CONSTRUCTS.md, 'Assembling'): what an Assembler builds. Written by the part kit (--gen-parts assembling): fix it, not this file. 'output' names a part, 'count' how many a batch makes (default 1), 'materials' the bulk materials (Recycling.json) and 'parts' the item parts it takes, 'seconds' the work at speed 1, 'minTier' the lowest tier of Assembler (default 1), 'machine' the family that builds it, when not the plain Assembler. At most 6 inputs; a physics-only part can't be an input.
